audit.why: Riot's GNAR! text: 'Mega Gnar throws everything around him in a chosen direction, dealing damage and slowing them. Any enemy that hits a wall is stunned and takes bonus damage.' The stun is conditional on being thrown into terrain — in the open middle of the lane it is a knock-back and a slow with no stun at all. Where you stand relative to walls decides whether his ultimate is a kill or an inconvenience, and that is free information the page never gives. The rage bar is the other half: Rage Gene means his transform is a resource, so 'when is he mini' is the real cooldown to track, and Hop (E, 22/19.5/17/14.5/12) is his only gap-closer in mini form.
